policy: Fixed positive RNG seeds shared by method; development seeds 0 and 1001-1010 are excluded from final repeat campaigns.
ompl_note: OMPL does not accept seed zero. Positive seeds avoid its implicit zero-to-one substitution.
development_note: Earlier exploratory low-DOF runs used seeds 0 and 1; manipulator diagnostics also used problem-index seeds. Registered repeat seeds therefore overlap with some development runs. Reports must disclose this overlap and must not call them entirely unseen trials.
final_v7_note: Held-out final seeds, never used for development or tuning before the v7 freeze (2026-11-24).
final_v8_note: Held-out v8 seeds registered on 2026-11-24 before any v8 run; never used for development or tuning (development used 1001-1010).
final_v9_note: Held-out v9 seeds registered on 2026-11-24 before any v9 run; development used 1001-1010.
final_v10_note: Held-out v10 seeds registered on 2026-11-25 (PC i9-14900) before any v10 run; development used 1001-1010.
final_v10b_note: Held-out v10b seeds registered on 2026-11-25 before any v10b run (after v10 results on 5001+ were seen; v10b reruns the uncontrolled Table I stage and the repeat/stability pairs on fresh seeds; no parameter changed between v10 and v10b except the post-hoc interval oracle, which gained Quad2D |v|/|omega| limits).
final_v2_note: flask_v2 held-out seeds registered on 2026-11-28 before any v2 held-out run; never used for development or lever selection (Phase 1/3 used 1001-1010). Both the v2 levers and the v1 literal protocol run on these seeds for a paired comparison.
low_dof_final_v2b_note: v2b (declared 2026-11-28, before any run on seeds 8001-8030). Only change from low_dof_v2_order2: the unicycle flat chart kappa (paper Eq. 10, kappa in {0,1} = forward/backward) of unicycle_wall is set to forward (reverse_chart false); unicycle_bugtrap stays backward. Evidence: paper Fig. 5a (results/diagnostics/v2_chart/paper_fig5a_crop.png): the drawn robot poses on Wall trail the direction of motion (forward), on Bugtrap they lead it (backward). The robot is a single sphere (paper Sec. VII-A), so kappa only changes the boundary lifts. The v10 choice (reverse on both maps) was made on development seeds when no evidence had been read. Found AFTER the 7001-7030 held-out results showed long Wall paths (results/diagnostics/v2_chart/chart_study.json, dev seeds 1001-1010), hence the fresh seed set. Levers stay frozen (no reselection).
generalization_v2_note: Registered 2026-11-28 with config/v2_generalization_rule.json, before any run on these seeds.
v2d_note: Registered 2026-11-28 with config/v2_shortcut_rule.json, before any run on these seeds. 1101-1130: development seeds for the L7 factorial. 8101-8130: held-out seeds for the v2d campaign (every Table I row), never used before.
